1. Exploration Theme — Cleyton Kauffman
Work: https://opengameart.org/content/exploration-theme
Author: https://soundcloud.com/cleytonkauffman
Original archive: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/exploration_theme.zip
Used: Exploration Theme/Exploration Theme.wav -> music-loop.mp3
Changes: Full 134.4-second composition retained; linear gain +5.08 dB from measured -25.08 LUFS toward -20 LUFS; encoded as 128 kbit/s MP3, 44.1 kHz stereo. No remix or melody replacement.

2. Interface Sounds (1.0) — Kenney
Work: https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds
Used: ten short cues listed by event and original filename in credits.json.
Changes: Selected cues downmixed to mono, standardized to 44.1 kHz signed 16-bit WAV, high-pass 70 Hz and low-pass 6500 Hz, short edge fades/padding, peak normalized to approximately -9 dBFS. Each exact filter is recorded in credits.json.
